text.formatted: The sword is Incapacitated while in the area of an Antimagic Field. If targeted by Dispel Magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall Unconscious for 1 minute.
text.plain: The sword is Incapacitated while in the area of an Antimagic Field. If targeted by Dispel Magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall Unconscious for 1 minute.

text.formatted: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.
text.plain: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.
